deck: Thanksgiving Day in Branson features a solid lineup of holiday-themed productions and variety shows, with multiple performances at King's Castle Theatre and evening options across several theaters. Family-friendly Christmas spectacles dominate alongside music, comedy hypnosis, and acrobatics.
